purpose: Explain historical departure patterns for the selected vehicle and date window, with timestamp eligibility, measured-distance coverage and sample floors.
primaryGoal: Understand when driving happens, compare weekday/weekend frequency, and evaluate departure consistency without mistaking descriptive evidence for prediction.

dataSources.name: useDriveCalendarHistory
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:3463-3464 registers /drives and GET / through driveHandler.ListByVehicle.
dataSources.behavior: Query key includes vehicle/start/end. Enabled only with all three. Fetches consecutive 1000-row pages, forwards AbortSignal, rejects non-array/oversize pages and invalid or duplicate IDs, returns only when a short page completes. Uses MODERATE stale time.
dataSources.unknowns: Server ordering, stable snapshot pagination, actual parameter interpretation and timezone-bound filtering were not inspected or exercised. Methodology's UTC date-only description is UI source, not backend proof.

dataSources.name: Workspace vehicle and range
dataSources.behavior: Selected vehicle comes from useSelectedVehicle; no local picker. Page uses start/end/timezone with all-time/page-preference options. Header-owned route override is important: useRangeState ignores those page preferences for this route.
dataSources.unknowns: useSelectedVehicle implementation and mounted shell behavior were not inspected.

dataSources.name: buildDrivingRhythm
dataSources.behavior: Memoized pure derivation using a page-mount frozen clock and one IANA timezone. Excludes malformed/future starts, preserves exclusions, groups weekday/hour/day/month, measures finite nonnegative SI distances separately, computes entropy scores, circular medians/deviations and ranked slots with sample floors.
dataSources.unknowns: No algorithm execution or fixture validation in this audit.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Both hourly and monthly sections mount a panel ChartContainer plus an EmbeddedChart adapter with a different chartKey and reduced data columns. These reuse the canonical renderer, so they are not competing libraries, but two hidden-series controllers and overlapping accessible-data contracts deserve reconciliation.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the existing outer export/data-table owner and reuse one legend state; retain existing persisted key semantics during any migration rather than silently resetting them.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The same complete-history coverage statement appears in the nested brief description and again in an amber-tinted callout.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Give the existing methodology/coverage owner one canonical explanation location, preserving the exact claim and all row counters while reducing repeated chrome.

sourceBehavior: Page stacks both five-column splits until xl, then assigns 3/2 spans (DrivingRhythmPage.tsx:28,94-104,113-123).
Punchcard has local overflow-x-auto around a 560px minimum grid (WeeklyPunchcard.tsx:92-101); full matrix is retained.
Comparison reflows into two cards at sm (WeekdayWeekendComparison.tsx:89).
Methodology becomes a 2fr plus minimum-20rem column grid at lg (DrivingRhythmMethodology.tsx:131).

issues.detail: Seven cards are forced into the xl consistency section, which itself receives only three fifths of the page. Each includes a compact OperationalBrief with rich description/scope and two metrics. Container-width compression is a source risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Use existing Grid/container-responsive strategy and wrap metric/metadata content without removing any weekday, sample count or explanation; verify long translations and 200% text.

issues.detail: Auto/minmax/auto row contains rank, contextual text and a nontrivial right-hand sample-floor label. Narrow containers and long translations can squeeze its center column.
issues.fix: Review at 320px and in the xl two-fifths allocation; reflow the existing count/floor block below contextual text if needed, preserving all content.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: UNVERIFIED at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560; no browser or screenshot run.

sourceStrengths: Localized section names, heading wrappers and hidden decorative icons.
Chart ariaLabel/dataColumns are supplied; query errors expose retry.
Section loading gate has role=status and a localized name.
Punchcard strongest-slot summary and per-cell native title strings exist.

issues.rule: MDC-040 chart alternatives and non-hover access
issues.detail: The 168-cell matrix is inside role=img, whose accessible name describes only the strongest slot. Counts are carried by native title on nonfocusable divs; no full table/text alternative or keyboard/touch cell interaction is present in this component.
issues.fix: Reuse the existing chart/data-table pipeline for a complete weekday/hour/count alternative, or add equivalent semantic text using current primitives; retain all 168 counts and strongest-slot summary. Do not create a second tooltip/focus system.

accessibility.acceptance: Keyboard, touch, screen reader, focus visibility, reduced motion, effective contrast, forced colors and RTL are UNVERIFIED. FadeIn is shared; its implementation was not inspected.

states.initialLoading: Page derives isLoading only from sourceState.status === initial; each shell stays mounted. Shared section body renders a named status/skeleton; charts receive loading; brief suppresses unavailable raw metrics.
states.empty: Each domain section has an EmptyState. Summary and punchcard link to /drives; hourly/monthly/comparison/consistency/slots are read-only empty states. Coverage distinguishes no returned rows from all rows excluded.
states.fatalError: Page passes fatalError rather than query.error to section gates. Retry calls drivesQuery.refetch. Shared summary adapter also renders QueryError.
states.retainedStale: StaleRefreshWarning remains beside all sections. Top brief receives stale/refresh-error retained flag. Existing summary computation uses retained drives, preserving charts on refresh failure.
states.offline: No local navigator/offline engine; uses existing query/data-trust pipeline. Actual paused/offline mounted rendering is unverified.
states.unknownPartial: Distance display uses measuredDistanceDrives and null instead of fabricated distance; predictability/consistency floors produce null. Invalid/future starts and distance coverage remain explicit.

issues.detail: Section state contains only isLoading/error/onRetry. NestedDrivingBrief supports retained but its rhythm consumers omit that prop. They therefore say Returned evidence while the top brief and page warning may correctly say Retained evidence. Methodology also shows Complete selected history whenever not loading/fatal, including refresh failure.
issues.fix: Extend the existing domain state with retained/source trust and pass it to existing nested briefs and coverage badge. Keep useful retained data and clarify freshness separately from pagination completeness.

visualIssues.detail: Five hardcoded cyan heatmap levels rise to 85% opacity. This is a real data encoding, not permission to delete color meaning; its saturated fixed hue bypasses current chart/theme palette ownership.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing palette/token ownership for a restrained sequential scale while preserving five levels, zero background, global normalization and native/current accessible labels. Validate composed contrast across themes.

visualIssues.detail: Methodology repeats cyan decorative icons; section headers additionally use cyan, indigo, emerald and amber. These fixed hues are presentation decoration rather than measured source semantics.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted icon/text tokens for structural decoration; retain meaningful supported/floor/rank Badge semantics and user-selected chart colors.

visualIssues.detail: Amber border/background frames an unconditional successful complete-pagination statement, suggesting a warning without a source warning condition.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border presentation for informational coverage, reserving warning tone for actual retained/error/partial evidence.

architectureIssues.detail: Header owns /driving-rhythm, but page sends date-only start/end rather than useRangeState startInstant/endInstantExclusive. The hook accepts only calendar strings. Rolling presets and timezone-specific midnight boundaries cannot be represented by this call contract.
architectureIssues.fix: Extend the existing calendar-history hook with typed precise bounds using the backend's verified supported parameters, preserving calendar start/end for normalization and UI labels. Inspect backend semantics before changing requests; no client-only current-page filtering.

architectureIssues.detail: Current mounted brief derives its public prop contract from ComponentProps of the alternate DrivingRhythmKpis renderer, despite mounting DrivingSummaryBrief instead.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse a concrete domain summary/state interface rather than coupling the active brief API to an alternate presentation implementation.

competingImplementations.detail: Alternate four-MetricCard summary remains exported from the rhythm barrel; assigned page mounts DrivingRhythmBrief. Its type is still used by the active brief. No proof that it is dead elsewhere.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep OperationalBrief as this page's active summary, decouple prop typing, and let owner resolve alternate adoption only with bounded caller evidence.

competingImplementations.detail: monthly-rhythm inner key and driving-rhythm-monthly outer key, like hourly-distribution and driving-rhythm-hourly, create independently persisted hidden-state scopes that are ORed. Both reuse shared ChartContainer through EmbeddedChart; not a new engine.
competingImplementations.fix: Reconcile within existing canonical frame contracts; preserve series persistence, full outer data columns and exports.

dataBehavior: Raw Drive distance remains SI meters; display preference conversion occurs in presentation, never wire/cache mutation.
Page freezes analysisNowMs at mount, excluding future starts relative to that clock; changing this is a business-behavior change.
One resolved IANA timezone groups all departures; invalid zone fallback is explicitly explained.
Do not discard malformed/future rows silently: retain observed/excluded counters and coverage.
Missing distance is not measured zero; measuredDistanceDrives controls distance availability.
Predictability floor 5, consistency floor 3, qualified-slot floor 3 and top-slot limit 6 remain.
Preserve all-history pagination, ID integrity validation, query key/enablement/cancellation/stale policy and retained refresh data.
Preserve date-only labels/denominator meaning while resolving precise API-bound mismatch; do not silently reinterpret normalized rates.
Retain locale/number/unit preferences, translated labels, existing chart keys/test IDs, all section shells and nonempty methodology in zero-drive success.
